subject: SDE-II (Serving Runtime) — question pool, slot prioritization, debrief plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Kara Lee <kara@recruitingpartners.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: SDE-II (Serving Runtime) — draft question pool + slot prioritization

Hi team,

We have Alex Gomez (SDE-II, serving runtime) on the calendar for next week. I attached a draft question pool and a one-page debrief rubric (both in attachments). I need two things from you by EOD Wednesday:

1) Which interview slots you can own (I listed a few proposed times in the doc).
2) Which focus areas we should prioritize from the pool (pick up to three).

Quick context: Alex has ~4 years building inference pipelines at a mid-size startup; flag if you want us to push for a different emphasis (e.g., more infra debugging vs. perf tuning).

My current proposed order: system design (60m) -> debugging/triage (45m) -> LLM-serving perf & KV-cache (45m) -> culture/collab (30m). Open to reshuffling.

Please reply inline if you have strong preferences. If someone can volunteer to be the bar-raiser, call it out — otherwise I'll ask Priyom (we've used him a lot lately but he can decline).

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Thanks for pulling this together. I can take the system design slot on Thursday morning (9:30–10:30 PT) or Friday 10:00–11:00 PT.

My priority focus areas:
- Runtime architecture & trade-offs (KV cache, eviction/consistency)
- Performance profiling and mitigation strategies (p95 vs p99)
- Incident triage / postmortem reasoning (how do they debug live issues)

Happy to serve as bar-raiser if you want — I can keep the rubric strict on safety, correctness, and operational rigor. If we rotate, maybe Marcus can own perf weighting.

—Priyom

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, Kara Lee <kara@recruitingpartners.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SDE-II (Serving Runtime) — draft question pool + slot prioritization

Thanks — a couple quick thoughts:

1) Candidate profile: Alex shipped model-serving features and owns latency budgets at current role. He may be weaker on distributed consensus primitives (noted in the resume). Given that, I suggest we shift emphasis slightly away from deep raft/consensus Qs and toward:
   - System design for low-latency inference (component trade-offs)
   - Debugging ambiguous perf regressions (what logs/metrics to examine)
   - Memory/quantization considerations at runtime

2) Weighting (how we score):
   - System design: 40%
   - Debugging/incident triage: 30%
   - Perf/implementation details: 20%
   - Team fit/collab: 10%

3) Slots: I can take the perf/implementation deep-dive on Thursday 1:00–1:45 PT. Lauren — can you own the culture/collab 30m slot on Friday?

If Priyom is comfortable being bar-raiser, I agree — keep the bar consistent for operational maturity.

Cheers,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: SDE-II (Serving Runtime) — draft question pool + slot prioritization

Thanks team. Happy to take the culture/collab slot on Friday 11:30–12:00 PT. A couple additions for the debrief flow:

- Please come prepared with one-paragraph takeaways (strengths, risks, red flags).
- Use the attached rubric to map to a pass/weak-pass/fail grid — but also include a short note if you want a follow-up technical task.
- If anyone sees a safety or data-handling risk during the interview, flag immediately to the hiring manager and HR; we should not rely on post-hoc notes for these.

On bar-raiser: Priyom, if you take the role, please call out any tie-break criteria we should use (e.g., we prefer operational maturity over narrow performance micro-optimizations).

Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Director, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference

Thanks all for the quick responses — finalizing: 

- Interview order (confirmed): System design (Priyom, Thu 9:30–10:30 PT) -> Perf deep-dive (Marcus, Thu 1:00–1:45 PT) -> Debugging/triage (open, Thu 2:15–3:00 PT) -> Culture/collab (Lauren, Fri 11:30–12:00 PT).
- Bar-raiser: Priyom — thanks for volunteering. Priyom, please use the attached rubric and call any tie-breaks on operational rigor vs. micro-optimizations.
- Weighting to use in debrief: System design 40 / Debugging 30 / Perf 20 / Fit 10.
- Deliverables after interview: one-paragraph takeaways from each interviewer (submit to GH candidate page) + quick consensus note (I will draft).

Attachments: SDE-II_question_pool_v3.docx, debrief_rubric_v1.pdf
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.example/candidates/8349
Calendar invites have been updated (see link).

If anyone needs to swap a slot, please tell Kara and me by EOD Monday so we can notify the candidate.

Alex — thanks for being flexible on timing. Kara, please confirm these invites to Alex.

See you all on Thursday.

Best,
Monica
